events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away in Las Vegas at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost him, Tupac's music still resonates with power and poetry. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today, 56 years after his untimely death.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the world lost a true guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix's influence is still unmatched. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' released 57 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road', featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover, was released 57 years ago today.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those tracks... pure timeless genius. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the powerhouse frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Chrissie Hynde is 75 today! Still rocking, still iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders track or Chrissie moment?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a formidable solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or Liam solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK 51 years ago today.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song that still inspires hope and peace around the world. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched a device that changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, which 007 is your ultimate spy, and what's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled artistry and enduring message of John Lennon. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today, 35 years after his death.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song thanks to Freddie?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since 'Rubber Soul' changed everything for The Beatles. This album truly marked a new era. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his death
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today, 46 years after his tragic death.

angles.name: Remembering John
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's the song that reminds you most of him?
